title: Outside the Purview of the Reward: Capability Drift in Multilingual Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.15717v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training can improve rewarded behavior while weakening capabilities users still need. We study two GRPO branches from a shared supervised checkpoint in a multilingual mixture-of-experts model. The released branch gains 36.07 points on MATH but loses 19.32 F1 points on XQuAD-Indic, while XQuAD-English improves under the same scoring rule. An independently trained sibling adds Indic instruction following and language-aware shaping. It recovers the regressing Indic task scores and preserves MATH, but does not restore script compliance and trades off competition mathematics and code. In a later round, judge training is followed by a sharp extraction decline from the Indic branch; reward-free distillation from its earlier checkpoint restores most of the lost F1. translated_title: 奖励范围之外：多语言后训练中的能力漂移
translated_abstract: 后训练可以在改善被奖励行为的同时，削弱用户仍然需要的能力。我们在一个多语言混合专家模型中，研究了从同一个监督检查点出发的两个GRPO训练分支。发布版分支在MATH上提升了36.07分，但在XQuAD-Indic上损失了19.32个F1分，而在相同评分规则下XQuAD-English反而有所提升。一个独立训练的姊妹分支增加了印度语系指令遵循和语言感知的塑形机制，它恢复了倒退的印度语系任务分数并保持了MATH成绩，但未能恢复文字规范遵循能力，并在竞赛数学与代码能力之间做出了取舍。在后续一轮训练中，裁判模型训练之后，印度语系分支的答案提取能力急剧下降；而利用其较早检查点进行的无奖励蒸馏恢复了大部分损失的F1。对MATH分数的分解显示，大部分测量到的增益来自框选答案输出的增加，而框选答案内部的准确率几乎没有变化。这些结果说明了为什么基准（此处原文被截断）……
tldr: 本文揭示多语言后训练中的“能力漂移”现象：被奖励的MATH分数提升主要源于框选答案输出增加而非真实推理能力改善，同时未被奖励的印度语系能力大幅退化，且可通过早期检查点的无奖励蒸馏部分恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals capability drift in multilingual post-training, showing that MATH gains largely stem from increased boxed-answer emission rather than genuine reasoning improvements, while unrewarded Indic-language capabilities regress and can be partially restored through reward-free distillation from earlier checkpoints.
